title: Besan Chilla
subtitle: Savory chickpea-flour crepes with warming spices — a fast, protein-rich breakfast.
protein: ~16–20g protein per adult · boosts to ~24g with paneer filling

nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Mix all batter ingredients — under 5 min, no soaking needed; batter improves overnight
Set aside toddler portion before adding chili; refrigerate both separately

method.title: Prepare batter (night before)
items: Whisk besan {1½ cups} with water {¾ cup} gradually to avoid lumps
Add ginger {1 tsp}, ajwain {½ tsp}, cumin seeds {½ tsp}, turmeric {¼ tsp}, coriander powder {½ tsp}, hing {¼ tsp}, salt {½ tsp}

method.label: Toddler — split before refrigerating
items: Remove ⅓ cup of batter before adding green chili or red chili powder
Add a few drops of ghee — keeps her chillas softer

method.title: Cook (morning)
items: Stir batter well — add water {2–3 tbsp} if thickened overnight
Add green chili {1} and red chili powder {¼ tsp} to adult batter
If using paneer filling: mix crumbled paneer {½ cup} with chaat masala {¼ tsp} and salt; set aside
Heat tawa on medium; grease with ghee {½ tsp}
Pour {¼ cup} and spread quickly; cook 2 min until edges golden
Add paneer filling {1 tbsp} in center if using; fold and press 1 min more

method.label: Toddler cooking
items: Cook on medium-low; small chillas {2 tbsp batter}, serve flat
A smear of ghee while warm adds calories

method.label: Tip
method.text: Ajwain aids digestion and gives the chilla its savory aroma. Besan batter thickens more than moong overnight — always loosen with water before cooking.
